magnitude.rule: >=10% of enemy anchors err>320 @r128, OR >=25% among staleness>30s

extraction.rule: construction tier p90 <= 160 AND self-consistency flags < 0.5%

stalenessTail.rule: p90 and %>2000 rise from <2s to 60-180s bucket (n>=50 each)

fixability.rule: >=50% of replays: median enemy-hero inter-anchor gap <= 60s post-10min

stalenessCausality.rule: median err non-decreasing across staleness buckets (n>=50) AND calib p90 <= 160
